_about: Single-site DCP chapters that name their site by street address only (or whose Lot/DP list no longer matches the cadastre). 'address_verbatim' is copied from the chapter page cited. scripts/build_site_boundaries.py --addresses expands it (a range 'a-b' with both ends odd or both even = every number on that side of the street, the NSW numbering convention; otherwise every number), finds each address in the NSW address register, takes the parcel it sits on, and refuses to build unless: the text is on the page; every number the chapter names exactly is found; no address just outside the range, or across the street, falls inside; the area matches when stated; and (Inner West) the nearest-outline fallback cannot reach a neighbour. Recorded 2026-10-11 (DQ-143).
